talk.text: Wait. Can six loose sheets really become one jury board?

scenes.credit: Law Garden community centre – the student's own drawings and models, used with permission

talk.text: This one did. A student's community centre for the Law Garden vendors, laid out on one A1 board with Studio FGA.
And that page of plain text about the intent?
It became the title and one line of concept at the top, so the jury gets your idea first.
Hold on. And that grey ground floor plan, what happened to it?
Same drawing, now with every room labelled, plus a north arrow and a scale bar.

outro: Okay, I need this. Where do I make my own?
